comingLast.roast: tied for last with Ellison - one of them buys, both of them stay
level pegging with Nicholson - the countback rules are being googled at the bar
safe by 1 - unless Nicholson finds form, in which case, gulp
finished with a 1-point buffer - his group is still reminding him hourly
2 above Nicholson and in - now it is all spectator sport with stakes
in with a 2-point moat - drawbridge stuck halfway up
his lead over Nicholson is 2 - a strong gust could move it
3 above the drop - hole by hole, point by point, beer by beer
only 3 clear of the blue balls - one blow-up and they are his
